title: PitchBook: companies developing brain-computer interfaces have already raised more than $1B in 2026, compared with $1.56B in the previous four years combined (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: PitchBook: companies developing brain-computer interfaces have already raised more than $1B in 2026, compared with $1.56B in the previous four years combined — Start-ups developing thought-controlled technology are drawing venture capital funding from Silicon Valley to Beijing.
